subject: Re: Octant Health - RFP bake-off: supplemental credits & SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Alice Garcia <alice.garcia@octanthealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@octanthealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP bake-off: request for additional eval credits and SOC2 artifacts

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput and latency profile you showed is compelling. Octant is running a tight RFP timeline (Decision slated for early July). We have one pressing ask: the incumbent vendor has offered a private pilot credit bundle that essentially doubles our usable trial capacity. To run apples-to-apples benchmarks across our 4 critical workflows we need an additional 400k token-equivalent credit top-up (in addition to the demo credits you already provided).

Separately, our security team needs SOC 2 Type II evidence (scope: prod infra, data handling) and an inventory of any third-party integrations before we can authorize the bake-off environment. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 bridge letter
- A concise integration inventory (names + data flow summary)
- A 30-day extension to the evaluation window if we need more time to set up the private runner

Budget/procurement are ready to sign a short PO for the pilot if we can agree on the credits and security deliverables. Appreciate a quick read — timelines are tight.

Best,
Alice
Alice Garcia
Director, Data Platforms — Octant Health
attachments: Octant_RFP_v3.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Garcia <alice.garcia@octanthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off: request for additional eval credits and SOC2 artifacts

Alice — really appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. Short answers up front: we can increase the eval allowance, and we can provide SOC2 documentation and a compact integrations list. A couple of constraints and suggestions:

1) Credits: we can authorize a 350k token-equivalent top-up today (bringing the total to 500k for the pilot) on a conditional basis: the PO or MSA signature and a short pilot acceptance criteria doc (two pages) that limits usage to the bake-off and scope of tests. To approve the full 400k you requested I need one-time credit approval from Ben (CC'd) because it exceeds the standard promo cap.

2) Security artifacts: we will share the SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA or via our secure share link. I will also attach a one-page integration inventory (service names + data flows) — low risk, no external consumer PII leaves the private runner.

3) Extension: we can grant a 30-day extension to the evaluation window starting on environment activation; we just ask procurement to confirm start date in writing.

If Ben approves the additional 50k tokens (to meet your 400k ask), we can wire the top-up in 24 hours and provision the private runner with the SOC2 link and inventory. Marissa, can you flag any cost considerations for this promo? Ben, tagging for approval.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — https://redwood.ai

Priyom — saw the thread. I can approve the extra 50k tokens to meet Octant's 400k ask, but with the following guardrails:
- Promo is a one-time eval top-up tied to deal DL-2025-0783.
- Credits expire 45 days after activation.
- Procurement must sign the pilot acceptance criteria and confirm go-live date.

Marissa — please create a quick quote note in the deal record and update projected ACV impact. Also prepare the SOC2 share link (secure) for outbound. Once the PO is in, Priyom, we can release funds.

Hi Alice — good news, Ben approved the additional 50k tokens. Summary of what we can do immediately: 

- Credit top-up: +400k token-equivalent (350k auto, 50k approved) — provisioned once we have a signed PO or email confirmation from procurement. Credits expire 45 days after activation.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report available via secure share (link below). Integration inventory attached.
- Extension: 30-day evaluation extension can be applied from activation date.

Secure link (access-controlled): https://redwood-secure-shares/reports/soc2_oct_2024 (access will be granted to octant.health domain).

Attachments: redwood_integration_inventory_v1.pdf (1 page)

Next steps (recommended): procurement sends PO dated with desired activation date; we provision credits and activate private runner; Octant shares test matrix; Redwood confirms start.

If procurement prefers, we can accept a signed PO and begin onboarding this week.

Best,
Priyom
